summary: CWE-482: the bad() method used the equality operator (==) where an assignment was intended. The line `if((isZero == (zeroOrOne == 0)) == true)` merely compares the uninitialized-intent `isZero` (always false) against the predicate without ever updating `isZero`, so the result of the SecureRandom draw is discarded. Fixed by assigning the predicate result to `isZero` and then testing it, preserving the feature (printing when zeroOrOne is 0 and reporting isZero's value).
